script: Decision: requires further review. The claimant reports a scratched door and broken side window, but does not know the cause; the policy covers vandalism and glass breakage other than from collision. Whether the damage resulted from a covered other-than-collision cause remains unresolved. Next action: Obtain a damage inspection and any available incident evidence to determine whether the door damage and glass breakage qualify as other-than-collision losses.
